edges.reason: Raw call data is decoded inside isTriggered.
Raw subscription data is decoded inside isTriggered.
isTriggered invokes parseCallInputs to decode CallParams.
isTriggered invokes parseSubInputs to decode SubParams.
Decoded CallParams are stored in triggerCallData.
Decoded SubParams are stored in triggerSubData.
isTriggered calls getRatio for current and next price checks.
vaultId parameter drives the ratio lookup.
nextPrice parameter selects the price used for the ratio.
getRatio resolves the ilk from the manager using the vaultId.
getRatio derives the price from nextPrice or getPrice.
getRatio calls getCdpInfo to obtain collateral and debt.
getCdpInfo returns the urn collateral.
getCdpInfo returns the rate-adjusted debt.
Collateral feeds the ratio calculation.
Debt feeds the ratio calculation.
checkedRatio is compared to produce shouldTriggerCurr.
checkedRatio is compared to produce shouldTriggerNext.
isTriggered calls shouldTrigger to evaluate the threshold comparison.
Current-price result flows into the returned boolean.
Next-price result flows into the returned boolean.
Ratio math uses DSMath wmul/rdiv fixed-point operations that can silently lose precision.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender with adminVault.owner() before allowing withdrawal.
onlyAdmin compares msg.sender with adminVault.admin() before selfdestruct.
changeOwner reverts unless admin equals msg.sender.
changeAdmin reverts unless admin equals msg.sender.
setOwner is guarded by the auth modifier using msg.sender.
isAuthorized compares src (msg.sender) against owner and authority.
startContractChange records block.timestamp as the change start time.
approveContractChange gates on block.timestamp versus the wait period.
startWaitPeriodChange records block.timestamp as the change start time.
approveWaitPeriodChange gates on block.timestamp versus the wait period.
kill executes selfdestruct on the contract.
selfdestruct forwards the remaining balance to the caller-supplied msg.sender.
withdrawStuckFunds performs a native ETH transfer when the token is the ETH sentinel.
Receiver parameter is the destination of the ETH transfer.
Amount parameter is the value of the ETH transfer.
sendValue performs a value-bearing low-level call to an arbitrary recipient that can reenter.
_functionCallWithValue calls an arbitrary target with data, allowing reentrancy back into the caller.
withdrawTokens sends native ETH when the token address is the ETH sentinel.
SafeERC20 wraps ERC20 calls through Address.functionCall.
DSProxyCache.write deploys bytecode using inline assembly CREATE.
read queries the cache mapping by code hash.
write stores the deployed target address in the cache mapping.
DSProxy.execute resolves the implementation through the proxy cache.
addNewContract writes a new Entry into the entries mapping.
startContractChange sets changeStartTime and inContractChange on the entry.
startContractChange stores the pending address.
approveContractChange promotes the pending address into the entry.
approveContractChange clears the pending address.
approveContractChange stores the old address in previousAddresses.
cancelContractChange resets the inContractChange flag on the entry.
cancelContractChange clears the pending address.
startWaitPeriodChange records the pending wait time.
approveWaitPeriodChange reads and clears the pending wait time.
approveWaitPeriodChange updates the entry wait period.
revertToPreviousAddress rewrites the entry contract address.
revertToPreviousAddress reads the previous address mapping.
getAddr reads the contract address from the entries mapping.
Registry id parameter keys the new entry.
New contract address parameter becomes the pending address.
Wait period parameter is stored in the entry.
addNewContract is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
startContractChange is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
approveContractChange is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
cancelContractChange is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
startWaitPeriodChange is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
approveWaitPeriodChange is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
cancelWaitPeriodChange is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
revertToPreviousAddress is restricted by onlyOwner using msg.sender.
New owner parameter is written into the owner state variable.
New admin parameter is written into the admin state variable.
Token parameter selects the asset being withdrawn.
Receiver parameter is the destination of the withdrawal.
Amount parameter is the quantity transferred.
